capabilities: Plan daily tasks and diary entries on a Today dashboard
Answer questions with cited vault excerpts and controlled writeback
Import and review PDF, Word, and web material into accepted knowledge
Build daily, weekly, monthly, and custom reviews from traceable evidence
Capture and hand off AI coding sessions as reusable project assets
disambiguation: Not just an AI chat plugin; most of it is a daily workspace for tasks, diary, knowledge import, and reviews.
extras: Freemium: local viewing, export, backup, and migration are free, but Pro workflows require a paid server-issued license or activation code. The browser capture extension is distributed separately from the community release assets, and full Chinese documentation lives in README.zh-CN.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in integrated daily planning, diary, review, and AI-assisted knowledge workflow, so users must piece together separate tools.

relations.evidence: Project Context keeps each project's Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode,
Life OS now implements the Weixin iLink Bot connection directly inside the plugin.

requires.name: Life OS license for Pro features
Weixin account for the Bot connection
Chrome/Edge companion extension and Claude Code CLI

summary: Local-first personal workspace that combines daily tasks, diary, knowledge, reviews, and a context-grounded AI assistant inside one Obsidian vault.
